note: One entry per clip. status: active (has a script and captions, built by make-demo-videos), blocked (cannot be recorded honestly yet; reason says what unblocks it), retired (kept for history, never built or posted). rerun_when says which screens the clip shows, so a release that touches them re-runs the clip.

clips.name: clip-cost
clips.feature: Money: month card, where the energy came from, receipts with price sources, off-peak savings
clips.rerun_when: web Money page or receipts list changes; monthly (the demo month rolls with the calendar)

clips.name: clip-share
clips.feature: Share a month card (cost off by default, made on device)
clips.rerun_when: share statement sheet or card changes; monthly

clips.name: clip-trip-1day
clips.feature: Trip planner: a one-way single-day sample plan on the map, itinerary and totals
clips.rerun_when: planner map, itinerary or trip summary changes; the sample trip presets change

clips.name: clip-planner
clips.feature: Trip planner redesign: drop a pin, what-if preview, add and reorder stops, Preferred only
clips.blocked_reason: The demo cannot show it: what-if is skipped in demo mode, Add as a stop would POST /api/trips/plan signed out, the Networks sheet is hidden, and the dropped pin is gone from the demo. Needs a read-only what-if (and stops) on the demo, a backend change.

clips.name: clip-trip
clips.feature: The original two-day sample trip clip
clips.retired_reason: Shows features held back from the beta wording (DA, Nov 8). Replaced by clip-trip-1day.
